note: Recorded generation response used offline (no token). The proprietary header vendor_adc.h is absent; the plan supplies a PRIVATE shim and a mock with explicit type/ABI assumptions from the SDD, without modifying the source directory. The return type is taken from the SDD (sample.raw saturated at 4095), which the missing header does not provide.

scenarios.title: vendor error returns zero and is called once

oracle.statement: If the vendor read does not return VENDOR_ADC_OK the function returns zero.
oracle.rationale: VND-002 states the zero return on any non-OK status.

scenarios.title: successful read returns the raw value

oracle.statement: On a successful read the function returns sample.raw.
oracle.rationale: VND-003 states the returned value on success.

omitted.reason: VND-003 saturation at 4095 (raw > 4095) exercises the comparator branch; it is asserted in the manual acceptance run rather than a generated case here.
